en.headline: Environment chief vows review of stray-dog management after Yuen Long death
en.dek: Tse Chin-wan said the government will examine the Dangerous Dogs Regulation and further reduce risks from strays, after three mongrels were caught near the attack site.
body: Environment and Ecology Secretary Tse Chin-wan said on Monday the government will review stray-dog management measures and the Dangerous Dogs Regulation following the death of a 27-year-old woman in a suspected dog attack in Yuen Long.

Tse expressed deep condolences to the family and said the incident was deeply saddening. Police and the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department had already caught three adult mongrels overnight near Pok Wai South Road; the animals are under observation while officers check for microchips.

He noted that annual captures of stray dogs have fallen from about 11,000 two decades ago to around 400 in recent years, showing progress, but the latest case showed more can be done to reduce risks. Most healthy strays are sterilised and returned; those in poor condition or posing danger may be humanely euthanised.

The Policy Address had already signalled a full review of the Dangerous Dogs Regulation, including stronger owner responsibilities and penalties. Search operations in the area will continue for a period to protect public safety.

zh.headline: 謝展寰：檢視流浪狗管理及危險狗隻規例 元朗襲擊後再加強措施
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰表示，政府將檢視流浪狗管理及《危險狗隻規例》，並加強狗主責任，元朗事件後已捕獲三隻唐狗作進一步觀察。
body: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰周一表示，元朗一名27歲女子懷疑遭狗隻襲擊死亡後，政府將檢視流浪狗管理措施及《危險狗隻規例》。
謝展寰向死者家人致以深切慰問，指事件令人傷痛。警方聯同漁農自然護理署已於壆圍南路一帶通宵行動，捕獲三隻成年唐狗，現正觀察及查核晶片。
他指出，二十年前每年捕獲約1.1萬隻流浪狗，近年已降至約400隻，顯示管理有成效，但今次事件提醒仍可做得更好以減低風險。大部分健康流浪狗會絕育後放回，身體欠佳或具危險性的則可能人道處理。
施政報告已提出全面檢視《危險狗隻規例》，包括加強狗主責任及罰則。當局會繼續在區內搜尋一段時間，以保障市民安全。
